ca0073cb1154cc.s: At what level did the RBI keep the repo rate unchanged in August 2026, while revising its 2026–27 CPI forecast to 5.0%?
ca0073cb1154cc.x: The repo rate stayed at 5.25% while the CPI forecast was trimmed from 5.1% to 5.0%; 5.00% is the SDF and 5.50% the MSF/Bank Rate.

cadf180348440b.s: India's insurance penetration in FY25 stood at:
cadf180348440b.x: Penetration was 2.7% of GDP in FY25; 3.2% was the pandemic peak.

ca0038279c5077.s: The IMF projected India's growth for 2027–28 at:
ca0038279c5077.x: The IMF put 2027–28 at 6.7%; its 2026–27 figure is 6.4%, and 6.6% is ADB's 2026–27 projection.

ca3aa98b810a8f.s: About how many farmers in India grow cotton?
ca3aa98b810a8f.x: About 6 million farmers grow cotton; 40–50 million people work in cotton processing and trade.

ca95e48a9cdb9d.s: The Asian Development Bank, which funds the North-East bamboo project, is headquartered at:
ca95e48a9cdb9d.x: ADB is headquartered in Manila; its bamboo loan is USD 42.2 million for 6 North-Eastern States.

cac13c04886bab.s: The revised Wholesale Price Index (WPI) has its base year as:
cac13c04886bab.x: The WPI base was moved forward from 2011–12 to 2022–23, and items rose from 697 to 957.

ca57de825be11a.s: In which year was the Solar Parks Scheme introduced?
ca57de825be11a.x: The Solar Parks Scheme came in 2014; the National Solar Mission was launched in 2010.

cab77193e8cd60.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about solar irrigation?
o: Groundwater irrigation emits 45–62 billion tonnes of CO₂ a year
Suryashakti Kisan Yojana is a scheme of Gujarat
In Bangladesh's fee-for-service model, solar irrigation was 20–30% cheaper than diesel
cab77193e8cd60.x: Groundwater irrigation emits 45–62 million tonnes of CO₂ a year, not billion tonnes.

ca0a9616e33af8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee?
o: It is chaired by a Deputy Governor
Its external members serve for 4 years
ca0a9616e33af8.x: The MPC is chaired by the RBI Governor, not a Deputy Governor.

cab69e054f9086.s: Which is the world's first equatorial Satellite-Based Augmentation System (SBAS)?
cab69e054f9086.x: India's GAGAN is the world's first equatorial SBAS.

ca8c49d136e048.s: The NRO account of non-resident Indians is used to:
o: Hold fixed deposits in foreign currency
Swap foreign currency with the RBI
ca8c49d136e048.x: NRO manages income earned in India; NRE parks foreign earnings and FCNR(B) is a foreign-currency account.

ca38ccc4b67fa2.s: Under Panchamrit, India's net-zero target year is:
ca38ccc4b67fa2.x: Panchamrit sets net-zero by 2070, along with 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030.

ca8522ce0c4c44.s: Operational airports in India rose from 74 in 2014 to how many by July 2026?
ca8522ce0c4c44.x: Operational airports rose from 74 to 165; India is the third-largest domestic aviation market.

ca7b89c9852d98.s: In which year did India propose One Sun One World One Grid (OSOWOG)?
ca7b89c9852d98.x: India proposed OSOWOG in 2018; GGI–OSOWOG was launched with the UK at COP26 in 2021.

ca223e4735f924.s: Which scheme installed more than 2.5 million solar pumps in five years and has a 2.0 version being prepared?
ca223e4735f924.x: PM-KUSUM installed more than 2.5 million solar pumps in five years, and PM-KUSUM 2.0 is being prepared.

cab4edf934d105.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UPI milestones?
o: UPI crossed 1 billion monthly transactions in October 2019
The BHIM app was launched in December 2016
Credit Line on UPI was introduced in 2019
cab4edf934d105.x: Credit Line on UPI came in 2023, not 2019.

ca72ffb4fc6fd2.s: Under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme, the effective interest rate for farmers is:
ca72ffb4fc6fd2.x: Loans at 7% with 3% prompt-repayment incentive bring the farmer's effective rate to 4%.

ca9dc5f62016aa.s: The FRBM Act came into effect in:
ca9dc5f62016aa.x: The FRBM Act came into effect in 2003; 2019 is the year the NSO was formed.

cae16285b046af.s: The first e-Toycathon was held in:
cae16285b046af.x: The first e-Toycathon was held in 2025; Toycathon itself dates to 2021.

ca20cc49c94dc3.s: Which is India's first river interlinking project?
ca20cc49c94dc3.x: Ken–Betwa is India's first river interlinking project.

ca2e4d34f68600.s: The National Critical Mineral Mission targets how many exploration projects by 2030–31?
ca2e4d34f68600.x: The Mission targets 1,200 projects; 777 are NMEDT projects, 457 GSI projects and 723 the blocks auctioned since 2015.

ca50c5fdbebcdc.s: 'Pani Bachao, Paisa Kamao' is a water-saving scheme of:
ca50c5fdbebcdc.x: Pani Bachao, Paisa Kamao is Punjab's; Haryana runs Mera Pani Meri Virasat and Gujarat Suryashakti Kisan Yojana.

ca6e3bffe06fc0.s: Under the BHAVYA industrial parks scheme, the NICDC–State participation ratio is:
ca6e3bffe06fc0.x: NICDC–State participation is 51:49; States give land and the Centre gives infrastructure.

ca7317da03f031.s: Under BHAVYA, what park size applies to mid-sized States?
ca7317da03f031.x: Mid-sized States get parks of 100–500 acres; up to 1,000 acres applies near cities and 25 acres in hilly/NE areas.

ca3c110aed9415.s: Which Bt cotton technology, with two stacked genes, was introduced in 2006?
ca3c110aed9415.x: Bollgard II came in 2006; Bollgard III and RR Flex were never commercialised.

cad9dbdedbb7a7.s: Which of the following PM MITRA parks is a Brownfield park?
cad9dbdedbb7a7.x: Amravati (Maharashtra) is Brownfield; Dhar, Navsari and Kalaburagi are Greenfield.

ca725521abece8.s: Karnataka's PM MITRA park is located at:
ca725521abece8.x: Karnataka's park is at Kalaburagi; Lucknow is in UP, Dhar in MP and Amravati in Maharashtra.

ca33a95a5bbfd7.s: The National Makhana Board was launched on 15 September 2025 in:
ca33a95a5bbfd7.x: It was launched in Bihar, after being announced in the Union Budget 2025–26.

ca6aaac8f0c102.s: India met its Maritime India Vision 2030 ship-recycling target how many years early?
ca6aaac8f0c102.x: India met the target five years early, in 2025.

ca547ef8ea72dc.s: In the IVF process behind the world's first Lakhimi female calf, which step comes right after egg collection?
ca547ef8ea72dc.x: The sequence is egg collection, maturation, fertilisation, embryo development and embryo transfer.

ca4e491795cb65.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UPI in the Maldives?
o: The Maldives is listed as the 12th country to adopt UPI
UPI was launched there on 30 July 2026
UPI was linked with the Favara system
Favara belongs to the Maldives Monetary Authority
ca4e491795cb65.x: UPI is live in 11 countries, so the Maldives is not the 12th.

caaa4156aba468.s: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) was established in:
caaa4156aba468.x: PNGRB was set up in 2006 under the PNGRB Act, 2006.

ca6317c80678df.s: GST came into effect in India on:
ca6317c80678df.x: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017, through the 101st Amendment Act, 2016.

ca2016872c953b.x: A bale weighs 170 kg; India is first in cotton area and second in production.

cae194f799e5a6.s: The Digital India Bhashini–GeM MoU provides for procurement in how many official languages?
cae194f799e5a6.x: The MoU covers all 22 official languages.

cadfa69c4a4630.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
1. Establishment of CPCL at Chennai
2. Establishment of GRSE at Kolkata
3. Introduction of the Navratna scheme
cadfa69c4a4630.x: GRSE was set up in 1884 at Kolkata, CPCL in 1965 at Chennai, and the Navratna scheme dates from 1997.

cac07a9fbceb2c.s: What effect does a weak rupee have on inflation in India?
o: It has no effect on prices
cac07a9fbceb2c.x: A weak rupee makes imports costlier and causes imported inflation; its export gains are limited by import content.

ca557eec48e86e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sugarcane production in 2024–25?
o: Uttar Pradesh had the largest share
Maharashtra had the largest share at 48.5%
ca557eec48e86e.x: Uttar Pradesh had the largest share (48.5%); Maharashtra's share was 24.1%.

caf7ffdbf18052.s: Gobindobhog, a GI aromatic rice, belongs to:
caf7ffdbf18052.x: Gobindobhog is from West Bengal; Kalanamak is UP's, Katarni Bihar's and Badshah Bhog Chhattisgarh's.

ca2a824762effd.s: Basmati rice earns about how many times more per kilogram than non-basmati rice?
ca2a824762effd.x: Basmati earns 2–2.5 times more per kg; it is transplanted in July during the monsoon.

caa96f9d68e212.s: Filled to capacity, India's Strategic Petroleum Reserves would meet about how many days of crude requirement?
caa96f9d68e212.x: At full capacity the SPRs cover only about 9.5 days, against the IEA norm of 90 days.

cac8a450c54b8b.x: LPG is propane and butane in cylinders; PNG is piped methane and LNG is methane cooled to about –160/–162°C.

ca2333c30b5957.s: Mission Anveshan, which uses satellite imagery for oil and gas exploration, is associated with:
ca2333c30b5957.x: Mission Anveshan is an ONGC exploration effort with Alpha Geo using satellite imagery.

ca1a737921199f.s: India's gross GST revenue in April 2026 was a record:
ca1a737921199f.x: April 2026 GST was a record ₹2.42 lakh crore; ₹2.23 lakh crore was April 2025.

cad2e57fabcfcf.s: S&P Global and CRISIL cut their FY 2026–27 India growth forecast from 7.1% to:
cad2e57fabcfcf.x: They cut it from 7.1% to 6.6%; their FY 2025–26 estimate was 7.6%.

ca55a5fceeae6e.s: Residential projects up to what cost are exempt from the 1% construction welfare cess?
ca55a5fceeae6e.x: Residential projects up to ₹50 lakh are exempt; the cess applies to all commercial projects.

ca84830979af75.s: ADB revised its FY 2026–27 India GDP forecast to:
ca84830979af75.x: ADB's revised figure is 6.8%; SBI Research is 6.6%, Moody's 6.0% and Ind-Ra 6.7%.

ca30b01090f515.s: The Reserve Bank of India was established in:
ca30b01090f515.x: The RBI was established in 1935 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

ca07cd56a68719.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's revised growth estimates?
o: Real GDP growth for FY 2025–26 was estimated at 7.6%
Nominal GDP growth for FY 2025–26 was 8.6%
The new GDP series uses 2011–12 as its base year
ca07cd56a68719.x: The new series has base year 2022–23, revised from 2011–12.

ca404163346c8f.s: Under the Current Weekly Status approach of employment surveys, the reference period is the last:
ca404163346c8f.x: CWS uses the last 7 days; Usual Status uses the last 365 days.

ca7b4f361fa280.s: The WTO Global Trade Outlook 2026 projects world goods trade growth in 2026 at:
ca7b4f361fa280.x: Goods trade growth is projected at 1.9% in 2026; 2.8% is world GDP growth and 4.6% was 2025 trade growth.

cad5e9065a72dc.s: The RBI–Bank of Japan currency swap arrangement was renewed up to:
cad5e9065a72dc.x: The RBI–BoJ swap was renewed up to $75 billion.

ca6ae3cd2379c0.s: Which institution provides long-term infrastructure finance and ESG financing?
ca6ae3cd2379c0.x: NaBFID provides long-term infrastructure and ESG finance; NIIF mobilises capital and InvITs monetise assets.

caa546352a73ce.s: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) became financially binding from:
caa546352a73ce.x: CBAM became financially binding from January 2026, and India got no exemption under the India–EU FTA.

caf97155fb7fd2.s: India imports its palm oil mainly from:
caf97155fb7fd2.x: Palm oil comes from Indonesia and Malaysia; sunflower oil from Russia and Ukraine.

cae48bded9abc4.s: The cotton production target under the Mission for Cotton Productivity is:
cae48bded9abc4.x: The production target is 498 lakh bales.

ca3f44780f4999.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sugar and jaggery?
o: A Chinese mission went to Maharashtra in 647 AD to learn sugar-making
The word 'sugar' comes from the Sanskrit 'sarkara'
Uttar Pradesh leads India in jaggery production
India produces over 70% of the world's jaggery
ca3f44780f4999.x: The 647 AD Chinese mission went to Magadha, not Maharashtra.

ca68a865e279bd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: GST was introduced through the 101st Constitutional Amendment, 2016
The GST Council is constituted under Article 279A
ca68a865e279bd.x: MPEDA is headquartered at Kochi, not Visakhapatnam.

cad40bc4f27b67.s: India has about how many domestic LPG connections?
cad40bc4f27b67.x: India has about 33 crore domestic LPG connections, around 10 crore of them added under PMUY after 2017.

cabf2040808ce1.s: India targets how much non-fossil power capacity by 2030?
cabf2040808ce1.x: India targets 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030 and net-zero by 2070.

ca027bf354e68e.s: About how many litres of water are needed to produce one kilogram of milled rice?
ca027bf354e68e.x: Milled rice needs about 3,000 litres/kg; paddy needs about 2,000 litres/kg.

o: Third, after China and the USA
ca34a45060f2b7.x: India is the second-largest gold consumer after China.

caaf3ceeb008a9.x: IRDAI, established in 1999, is headquartered in Hyderabad.

ca805484200e04.s: South Central Railway is headquartered at:
ca805484200e04.x: South Central Railway is headquartered at Secunderabad; Visakhapatnam is HQ of the new South Coast Railway.

cac2ec79248bee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ethanol and sustainable fuels in aviation?
o: Ethanol and synthetic hydrocarbons are permitted in ATF
Sustainable Aviation Fuel can cut lifecycle emissions by 60–80%
Ethanol has about 27% less energy per litre than petrol
A mandatory 20% ethanol blending target for ATF has been fixed
cac2ec79248bee.x: No mandatory blending target for ATF has been fixed yet.

ca1c752d637c96.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the United Kingdom's response to inflation?
o: The UK avoided recession after the rate hikes
The Bank of England adopted aggressive rate hikes
UK CPI was about 3% in February 2026
ca1c752d637c96.x: The UK entered recession in late 2023 after the aggressive hikes.

ca7290717fc28a.s: Under Flexible Inflation Targeting, India's CPI inflation target is:
ca7290717fc28a.x: The target is 4% CPI with a ±2% band, in force since 2016.

caf3889d95ff8e.s: The N:P₂O₅:K composition of DAP is:
caf3889d95ff8e.x: DAP is 18:46:0; the FCO, 1985 was issued under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.

ca4074ff186311.s: Ethanol blending of 19.24% was achieved in which Ethanol Supply Year?
ca4074ff186311.x: The 19.24% blending figure relates to ESY 2024–25.

ca64e40f002a7c.s: Under Schedule VI of the Fertiliser Control Order, 1985, biostimulants are divided into how many categories?
ca64e40f002a7c.x: Schedule VI, introduced in February 2021, has nine categories of biostimulants.

ca76dae7210548.s: Aircraft noise and emissions are covered under which ICAO Annex?
ca76dae7210548.x: Noise and emissions fall under ICAO Annex 16.

ca4fc9517b95f5.s: The UDAN scheme, covering 90 airports, 15 heliports and 2 water aerodromes, has connected how many routes?
ca4fc9517b95f5.x: UDAN has connected 625 routes; 102 new routes were added in 2024.

ca8655d80d12bb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the World Bank's lending framework for India?
o: The lending framework runs for ten years
It provides USD 8–10 billion a year
It was finalised with World Bank President Ajay Banga
It was finalised with Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
ca8655d80d12bb.x: The framework runs for five years, not ten.

ca81df9338f8c6.s: The Dedicated Freight Corridor announced in the Union Budget 2026–27 runs from:
ca81df9338f8c6.x: The new Dedicated Freight Corridor runs from Dankuni in the east to Surat in the west.

caf2e8ad544b59.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Soil Health Card scheme?
o: More than 25 crore cards have been distributed
It is linked to the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture
caf2e8ad544b59.x: Soil Health Cards are issued every two years, not every 10 years.

caa6f9e702b8fa.s: The old Pamban railway bridge was opened in:
caa6f9e702b8fa.x: The old Pamban bridge, about 2.3 km long, was opened in 1914.

caa4637a5464b5.s: How many members of the RBI's six-member MPC are from the Central Government?
caa4637a5464b5.x: The MPC has 6 members: 3 from the RBI and 3 nominated by the Centre.

ca75fc4ba0ee16.s: Bank-issued infrastructure bonds, unlike InvITs, offer:
ca75fc4ba0ee16.x: Infrastructure bonds give fixed interest with a fixed tenure; InvIT returns are market-linked.

ca5e505a2492c2.s: Under the revised MSME definition from 1 April 2025, the turnover limit for a small enterprise is:
ca5e505a2492c2.x: A small enterprise's turnover limit is now ₹100 crore; ₹50 crore was the old limit.

ca0a9aec4cb456.s: Al Hind Air, given a NOC in December 2025, is based in:
ca0a9aec4cb456.x: Al Hind Air is based in Kochi; Shankh Air is linked to the Noida region and FlyExpress to Telangana.

ca3050f3a0ea49.s: Startup India, launched in 2016, is run by:
ca3050f3a0ea49.x: Startup India is under DPIIT of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, not MeitY.

ca979f0ccc48d8.s: The GST Council is constituted under Article:
ca979f0ccc48d8.x: The GST Council is under Article 279A; Article 280 deals with the Finance Commission.

cac5e96fc4571d.s: PM Vishwakarma, with 30 lakh registrations in two years, covers how many trades?

ca0444b1a42d81.s: India's share in US rice imports in 2024 was:
ca0444b1a42d81.x: India's share of US rice imports was 26.1%; 40% is its approximate share of global rice trade.

ca0310297318cd.s: The PMO moved to the new Seva Teerth building from:
ca0310297318cd.x: The PMO moved to Seva Teerth from South Block.

ca0e9474153cb5.s: SHE Marts announced in the Union Budget 2026–27 are:
o: Government-owned outlets at the district level
Private franchise outlets in Tier-2 towns
Community-owned retail outlets at cluster-level federations
ca0e9474153cb5.x: SHE Marts are community-owned outlets at cluster-level federations, not government-owned district outlets.

caf12fd366c7fd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Household Income Survey and ASISSE?
o: They will be conducted by the NSO
They will be conducted through CAPI
The Household Income Survey will be India's first
caf12fd366c7fd.x: Both surveys begin from April 2026, not May.

caa2d571a9eca2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the DGCA and Indian aviation?
o: The DGCA is an attached office of the Ministry of Civil Aviation
The DGCA is headquartered in New Delhi
Kingfisher, Jet Airways, Go First and TruJet are among airlines that failed
India is the world's second-largest domestic aviation market
caa2d571a9eca2.x: India is the third-largest domestic aviation market, not the second.

ca1f1514dedb88.s: Transplanted paddy requires about how many irrigations in a season?
ca1f1514dedb88.x: Transplanted paddy needs 25–27 irrigations, and continuous flooding raises methane emissions.

caf114f334f302.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Niryat Protsahan of the Export Promotion Mission?
o: It is under the Department of Commerce
It focuses exclusively on large industrial exporters
Interest subvention on pre- and post-shipment credit is one of its pilot measures
It is a component of the Export Promotion Mission
caf114f334f302.x: Niryat Protsahan focuses on MSMEs, not exclusively on large exporters.

caa9d4a6133b2d.s: India's share in global merchandise exports in 2024 was:
caa9d4a6133b2d.x: India's share was 1.8% in 2024, per the Economic Survey 2025–26.

ca992927caad09.s: According to NITI Aayog, India may achieve about how much food surplus by 2035?
ca992927caad09.x: NITI Aayog says India may achieve about 20% food surplus by 2035.

ca9c892b488ac7.s: ReALCRaft is a web-based platform for:
o: Online registration and licensing of fishing vessels
ca9c892b488ac7.x: ReALCRaft handles online registration and licensing of fishing vessels.

caff7ca1d72dee.s: A DPIIT-recognised startup must have an annual turnover below:
caff7ca1d72dee.x: The startup turnover limit is below ₹100 crore.

ca44d2e13f5d5b.s: Banas Dairy's circular model can raise farmers' incomes by about how much over five years?
ca44d2e13f5d5b.x: The circular model can raise incomes by about 20% over five years; Banas is Asia's largest dairy cooperative.

ca71125f4130f4.s: In 2025, how many mainboard IPOs together raised over ₹1 lakh crore?
ca71125f4130f4.x: 71 mainboard IPOs raised over ₹1 lakh crore in 2025.

ca2da9d6f34c57.s: In market behaviour, Bitcoin behaves like:
ca2da9d6f34c57.x: Bitcoin behaves like a risk asset, not like digital gold.

ca5aa3bf92fa17.s: The Lead Bank Scheme, launched in 1969, was based on the recommendation of the:
ca5aa3bf92fa17.x: The Lead Bank Scheme came from the Nariman Committee's recommendation.

new.s: Which rate is now the floor of the RBI's liquidity adjustment corridor?
new.x: The SDF (5.00%) has replaced the reverse repo as the floor; MSF = Bank Rate = 5.50% is the ceiling.

new.s: As of August 2026, the Cash Reserve Ratio stood at:
new.x: The CRR is 3% of NDTL after a 100 bps cut.

2. The decision was unanimous.
3. The policy stance was changed to accommodative.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: August was the 4th straight hold and was unanimous; the stance has stayed neutral since June 2025.

new.s: In August 2026, the MPC revised its 2026–27 real GDP growth forecast to:
new.x: The MPC raised its 2026–27 GDP forecast from 6.6% (June) to 6.7% (August).

new.x: The MPC is under Section 45ZB; Section 53 governs the RBI's surplus transfer.

Food has a higher weight in the CPI than in the WPI

new.x: The new Output PPI (base 2022–23) is now the IIP deflator instead of WPI.

new.x: It will be released monthly on the 29th with a lag of about 60 days.

new.x: WPI inflation was 9.78% in July 2026 after nearly 10% in June, a cost-push rise.

new.s: ADB projected India's growth for 2027–28 at:

new.s: In 2025–26, the Centre met its fiscal deficit target of:

new.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 provides 4,000 electric buses for:
new.x: 4,000 e-buses are planned for the Purvodaya States.

new.s: Who is the Chief Economic Adviser associated with the Economic Survey 2026?
new.x: V. Anantha Nageswaran is the Chief Economic Adviser.

new.x: Maize yield rose to 3.78 t/ha in FY25.

new.x: It is part of ₹350 crore for high-value agriculture: coconut, cashew and cocoa.

new.x: July 2026 was the third-highest; the highest is April 2026 at ₹2.43 lakh crore.

new.s: Gross GST collections for 2025–26 were:

new.s: Under the Next-Generation GST reforms, the registration threshold for goods was raised from ₹20 lakh to:
new.x: The goods threshold rose from ₹20 lakh to ₹40 lakh.

new.x: UPI, developed by NPCI and regulated by the RBI, is built on IMPS.

new.s: By August 2026, UPI was live in how many countries?
new.x: The list rose from 8 countries in March 2026 to 11 by August 2026.

new.s: Which country issued the world's first polymer currency notes, in 1988?
new.x: Australia issued the first polymer notes in 1988; Canada, the UK and Singapore followed.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the RBI's experimental polymer notes:
1. 100 crore units each of ₹10 and ₹20 notes are planned.
2. Polymer notes last 2.5–6 times longer than paper notes.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: 100 crore units each of ₹10 and ₹20, lasting 2.5–6 times longer.

new.s: The EPF interest rate for 2025–26, fixed by the CBT, is:
new.x: The CBT kept EPF at 8.25% for the third straight year; the Finance Ministry concurred in June 2026.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about small savings rates for July–September 2026:
1. The Public Provident Fund carries 7.1%.
2. The National Savings Certificate carries 8.2%.
3. The Senior Citizens Savings Scheme carries 8.2%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Small savings rates were unchanged: PPF 7.1%, NSC 7.7%, Sukanya Samriddhi and SCSS 8.2%.

new.s: Which insurance initiative–feature pair is correctly matched?
new.x: Bima Vahak is women-led distribution; Bima Sugam is the digital marketplace and Bima Vistaar the affordable product.

new.s: NABARD, which marked its 45th Foundation Day on 12 July 2026, was established in:
new.x: NABARD was established in 1982.

new.s: The BHAVYA scheme for 100 industrial parks has an outlay of:
new.x: BHAVYA's outlay is ₹33,660 crore; ₹28,840 crore is Modified UDAN and ₹84,084 crore Samudra Manthan.

new.s: Which scheme–outlay pair is correctly matched?
new.x: PM MITRA's outlay is ₹4,445 crore; BHAVYA is ₹33,660 crore, Modified UDAN ₹28,840 crore and Samudra Manthan ₹84,084 crore.

new.s: India's record seafood exports of 2025–26 went mainly to:
new.x: The top buyers were the USA and China.

new.s: India and France, with trade of USD 15.81 billion in 2025–26, target trade of how much in five years?
new.x: The target is USD 32 billion in five years.

new.s: In FY 2025–26, UPI transactions were worth a record:
new.x: UPI handled ₹314 lakh crore in FY 2025–26, about 4,000 times the 2016–17 value.

new.s: UPI first crossed 2,000 crore monthly transactions in:
new.x: It first crossed 2,000 crore in August 2025; October 2019 was the 1 billion mark.

new.s: Public Sector Banks' gross NPA ratio at the end of FY 2025–26 was:
new.x: PSBs posted a record ₹1.98 lakh crore profit with GNPA at 1.93%.

new.s: RBI's Mission Saksham is a capacity-building initiative for:
new.x: Mission Saksham builds capacity in urban cooperative banks, with about 1.4 lakh participants.

new.s: Under RBI Utkarsh 2029, Project SA-MUDRA relates to:
new.x: Project SA-MUDRA is the currency project of the medium-term strategy Utkarsh 2029.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the EPF interest rate for 2025–26:
1. It was fixed at 8.25%.
2. It was fixed by the Central Board of Trustees on 2 March 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The CBT, chaired by Mansukh Mandaviya, fixed 8.25% for the third straight year.

new.s: For April–June 2026, the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana carries an interest rate of:
new.x: Rates were unchanged: SSY and SCSS 8.2%, PPF 7.1%, NSC 7.7%.

new.s: In 2025–26, which country overtook the USA as India's biggest trading partner?
new.x: China overtook the USA, with trade of $151.1 bn.

new.s: Which pair about India's external sector is correctly matched?
o: Trade deficit with China in 2025–26 – $112.16 bn
new.x: The China deficit was $112.16 bn; China (not the USA) was the biggest partner, remittances were US$137 bn and exports USD 860 bn.

new.s: India, the world's largest remittance recipient, received about how much in 2024?
new.x: India received US$137 bn in 2024, the only country above US$100 bn.

new.s: The Monetary Policy Framework Agreement between the Government and the RBI was signed in:
new.x: The Agreement dates to February 2015; the MPC was constituted in September 2016.

new.s: In its April 2026 policy, the RBI put FY 2026–27 inflation at:
new.x: The RBI held the repo at 5.25% and estimated FY27 inflation at 4.6%.

new.s: The Index of Core Industries is compiled by the:
o: Office of the Economic Adviser (Commerce and Industry)
new.x: The monthly Index of Core Industries is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser.

new.s: How many sectors does the revised Index of Core Industries cover?
new.x: It covers 9 sectors after iron ore was added; electricity has the highest weight.

new.s: Gross GST collection in March 2026, the first March above ₹2 lakh crore, was:
new.x: March 2026 GST was ₹2,00,064 crore; February was ₹1.83 lakh crore and April 2026 ₹2.42 lakh crore.

new.s: The CBDT functions under which law?
new.x: The CBDT was constituted under the Central Boards of Revenue Act, 1963, and functions from 1 January 1964.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about LPG and natural gas?
o: LNG is stored in cryogenic tanks
new.x: LPG (propane and butane) is heavier than air; LNG and PNG are methane, lighter than air.

new.s: The PNGRB regulates which segment of the petroleum and natural gas sector?
o: Downstream activities such as refining, storage and distribution
new.x: PNGRB regulates only the downstream segment, not crude or gas production.

new.s: Which Kharif MSP 2026–27 pair is correctly matched?
new.x: Moong has the highest margin (61%); sunflower seed got the largest rise, sesame the highest oilseed MSP and maize the smallest rise.

new.s: Under the Budget 2026–27 AEO 'Clear First – Pay Later' facility, deferred payment was extended from 15 days to:
new.x: Deferred payment for Tier 2 and 3 AEOs was extended from 15 to 30 days.

new.s: India Ratings (Ind-Ra), a Fitch subsidiary, revised its FY 2026–27 forecast from 7.6% to:
new.x: Ind-Ra cut its forecast to 6.7%, assuming crude at about US$95.

new.s: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran projected FY 2026–27 growth at:
new.x: The CEA projected 7–7.4% for FY27, with the economy possibly crossing $4 trillion.

new.s: The Macro-Economic Framework Statement presented with the Budget is mandated by:
new.x: It is required by the FRBM Act, 2003, not by a constitutional article.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Budget concepts:
1. The Annual Financial Statement is presented under Article 112.
2. The Macro-Economic Framework Statement is mandated by the Constitution.
3. A vote-on-account covers expenditure only.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: 1 and 3 are correct; the Macro-Economic Framework Statement is required by the FRBM Act, 2003, not the Constitution.

new.s: A vote-on-account covers:
new.x: A vote-on-account covers expenditure only; an interim budget covers both expenditure and receipts.

new.s: The revenue deficit for 2026–27 (BE) is set at:
new.x: The revenue deficit is 1.5% of GDP; 4.3% is the fiscal deficit.

new.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 set a debt–GDP target for 2030–31 of:
new.x: The target is 50 ± 1% of GDP by 2030–31.

new.s: The 16th Finance Commission retained vertical devolution to States at:
new.x: The 16th Finance Commission retained 41% vertical devolution.

new.s: From 1 April 2026, the Minimum Alternate Tax rate was cut from 15% to:
new.x: MAT became a final tax at 14%, down from 15%.

new.s: The new Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force from:
new.x: The new Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2026.

new.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much for Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage over five years?
new.x: CCUS gets ₹20,000 crore over five years; ₹10,000 crore is the SME Growth Fund.

new.s: The concept of Universal Basic Income was introduced in the Economic Survey of:
new.x: UBI appeared in the Economic Survey 2016–17; Thalinomics came in 2019–20.

new.s: Which concept–Economic Survey pair is correctly matched?
new.x: Thalinomics was in the Economic Survey 2019–20 and Universal Basic Income in 2016–17.

new.s: The Economic Survey 2025–26 raised India's medium-term potential growth to:
new.x: Potential growth was raised from 6.5% to 7%.

new.s: After the RBI's February 2026 policy, the reverse repo rate stood at:
new.x: The reverse repo is 3.35%; SDF is 5%, repo 5.25% and MSF 5.50%.

new.s: With the December 2025 cut to 5.25%, cumulative repo cuts since February 2025 reached:
new.x: The 25 bps cut in December 2025 took cumulative cuts to 125 bps.

new.s: In February 2026, the RBI raised its current-year GDP growth projection from 7.3% to:
new.x: The RBI raised its current-year projection from 7.3% to 7.4%.

new.s: In February 2026, the RBI raised the limit of collateral-free loans for MSEs from ₹10 lakh to:
new.x: The collateral-free limit rose from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh.

new.s: The shift of the GDP base year to 2022–23 is India's:
new.x: MoSPI's move to 2022–23 is the ninth base revision, released on 27 February 2026.

new.s: GST rates were cut on 375 items with effect from:
new.x: GST cuts on 375 items applied from 22 September 2025.

new.s: In the January–March 2026 small savings rates, the PPF rate was kept at:
new.x: PPF stayed at 7.1%; POMIS is 7.4%, NSC 7.7% and Sukanya Samriddhi 8.2%.

new.s: Kisan Vikas Patra, carrying 7.5% interest, matures in:
new.x: KVP at 7.5% matures in 115 months.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025?
o: It raised cooperative bank directors' maximum tenure to 15 years
It raised the 'substantial interest' threshold to ₹2 crore
It permits up to four nominees per account
new.x: The tenure rose from 8 to 10 years (not 15), in line with the 97th Amendment.

new.s: NPCI's UPI Help Assistant model, built with NVIDIA's Nemotron models, is called:
new.x: The model is 'Fimi'; 'Bharati' is the AI assistant of Bharat-VISTAAR.

new.s: Which initiative–body pair is correctly matched?
o: ASPIRE – Department of Science and Technology
new.x: GENESIS is MeitY's deep-tech platform; ASPIRE is under the Ministry of MSME, NIDHI under DST and SVEP under DAY-NRLM (MoRD).

new.s: E20 petrol became mandatory nationwide from:
new.x: E20 petrol (RON 95) became mandatory nationwide from 1 April 2026.

new.s: India's first independent regulator was:
new.x: TRAI (1997) was the first independent regulator, not PNGRB.

new.s: The OECD projected India's growth for 2025–26 at:
new.x: The OECD projected 6.7%; the IMF and RBI had 7.3%, the World Bank and ADB 7.2%.
